faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Research Associate-1 recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Research Associate-1 position at IIT Guwahati is 18 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-1 post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or allied disciplines, along with relevant hands-on experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-1 position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 58,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for the Research Associate-1 post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate-1 position will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for this recruitment through the Online mode only.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Associate-1 post at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Research Associate-1 position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: IIT Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q10. Will there be any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories, as it is not explicitly mentioned in the provided data.
